audit.why: MEMORY authority (champ-gender.js) and the lintFindings MISGENDER hit both confirm Yuumi is female; the owner (Thresh) is addressed as "you", so the third-person pronoun refers to the enemy.
phases[].side (all Thresh) already agrees with content win[0-6] (all Thresh) and packet.levelChart (all Thresh) — no chart contradiction here.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Death Sentence (Q) cancels Final Chapter (R)'s channel and that Yuumi is untargetable while attached — breakdown.cooldowns had no digits and didn't name the channel-interrupt.
audit.why: You and Me! (W) makes Yuumi untargetable except to turrets; Final Chapter (R) is a channel any CC (including Death Sentence's bind) cancels outright — real, actionable mechanics missing from the page.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with real cooldown numbers and the channel-cancel fact.
